Riley (Logs): Starting log hunt. Quick reminder: hot logs retained ~30 days, cold/archived ~365 days; if it's older than 30d we may need a restore (6-8h). For this timestamp it's within hot retention. Use this Kibana/KQL snippet in Discover:

```

| sort @timestamp desc
```

Alex (SRE): If you want to reproduce locally, run a minimal curl that mirrors the customer's call (without their key). Example we use in support sandbox:

```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"short test", "request_id":"abc123-req-0007", "model":"gpt-small"}'
```
Note: do not paste customer key in public channels.
